Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: GX frame heap 4 MB (fixes the crash after ~1 hour)
Metadata.Author: GameOClock
Metadata.Note: The renderer's two per-frame heaps are 256 KB each. Their use grows slowly while playing (about 3-6 KB per minute) and when one is full a GXWorker thread copies into a null pointer: the game ends with an access violation in memcpy (ucrtbase.dll+0xee4b3), after 65-80 minutes in every recorded case. This raises both heaps to 4 MB (mov edx, 0x40000 at 0x2195c09 and 0x2195c46 in the eboot), 16 times the room.
